title: Retro gaming is being overrun with AI
script:
AI is accelerating the porting of classic games to modern platforms.
Developers are using AI to automate the tedious decompilation and recompilation of older game code.
This allows titles like Halo to run inside a web browser.
Wind Waker is now playable on an iPhone.
Super Smash Bros is even appearing in mixed reality headsets.
These viral projects have surged in frequency over the last thirty days.
The Verge reports these tools make porting accessible to people outside of professional studios.
Would you play your childhood favorites if they were AI-ported to your phone?

LINE 8: Change to 'Would you play your childhood favorites if they were AI-ported to your phone today?'
